cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while the needs and coverage records use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Observed Job 2 priorities all have upstream_rank: 0, showing provenance ranks were not matched to coverage record_ids.

assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': ..., 'rank': index}, replacing the demand record_id with source_id.
initial_receipt.explanation: The downstream output shows every priority has upstream_rank 0 because the evidence_sources handoff uses source ids as record_id values, so Job 2 cannot join provenance ranks back to need record_ids. The supplied upstream source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the original demand record_id. This violates the criteria to preserve record identity/provenance and to rank by upstream provenance order.
